lead: `conformance_coverage.rs` counts only the fully qualified call spelling, so cases that write `Test::member(` under a `use Core\Test;` are reported as "asked by 0 case(s)".
body: The gate builds `{class}::{name}(` from the registry row and asks whether the corpus contains it, and `corpus::Attribution` indexes a case the same way, so an aliased call site is invisible to both and two tests fail without saying the word alias. Write the member's FQ spelling at least once per case; the surrounding calls may stay aliased.
